top_issues: Home desktop: severe dead space on the bottom half of the wide viewport; the primary column terminates abruptly under the USDC balance item while the right rail terminates under Recent activity.
Home desktop: the dual-bar breakdown under the total balance is visually detached from the balance tier legend below it, requiring vertical eye scanning between colors and numbers.
Home desktop: 'send up to 60,000.00 / receive up to 40,000.00' text under the account bar has low optical contrast against the dark card surface (#12131A).
fixes: Home desktop: wrap the two-column grid in a container max-width of 1120px or expand lower module content (e.g. detailed account matrix / extended transaction feed) to balance vertical rhythm across viewports.
Home desktop: align the tier legend (On-chain, Reserve, Accounts) directly beneath each corresponding colored bar segment as micro-labels or a unified segmented breakdown component.
Home desktop: bump secondary sub-bar caption contrast from rgba(255,255,255,0.4) to rgba(255,255,255,0.65).

top_issues: Pay desktop: 'This payment' 25.00 bar in the amount input card renders as an almost imperceptible 0.5px line at the current scale ($50/px), making zero vs active entry indistinguishable.
Pay desktop: 'Add a note >' link floats with excessive detached whitespace above the primary CTA button.

Pay desktop: Right column 'YOUR ACCOUNT WITH HUB ONE' Before/After comparison is exceptionally clear, but the small descriptive footnote '25.00 nets what Hub One owes you...' lacks visual prominence given its critical settlement context.
fixes: Pay desktop: enforce a min-width of 2px with an active glow/marker for non-zero payment amounts on the visceral bar to guarantee visual feedback.
Pay desktop: integrate 'Add note' as an inline expandable input within the payment spec table rather than a floating bottom-left text trigger.
Pay desktop: move the explanation text ('25.00 nets what Hub One owes you...') into an explicit callout block matching the Provable panel styling.

top_issues: Receipt desktop: modal omits the visceral value bar entirely, missing the chance to anchor the committed $25 reduction against the remaining balance scale visually.
Receipt desktop: execution duration 'in 2044 ms' uses mint accent identical to the settlement status, visually conflating operational latency with cryptographic success.
Receipt desktop: background backdrop scrim blur is slightly dark/opaque, completely occluding the updated background state which would otherwise reinforce instant ledger balance adjustment.
fixes: Receipt desktop: add a mini post-settlement delta bar under '25.00 USDC' depicting the committed slice moving out of bilateral capacity.
Receipt desktop: change 'in 2044 ms' styling to muted monospace text (rgba(255,255,255,0.5)) next to the timestamp.
Receipt desktop: tune backdrop filter to `backdrop-blur-md bg-black/40` so the updated background balance ($11,475.00) remains subtly readable behind the modal.

top_issues: Receive desktop: QR code container is stark raw off-white (#F5F5F0) without a framing border or subtle inset, creating an aggressive optical glare in dark mode.
Receive desktop: vast empty void between the form inputs and the bottom of the viewport; layout feels like an unanchored mobile card centered on a 1440p monitor.
Receive desktop: 'Copy xln:// app link' text button sits awkwardly separated below the two primary pill buttons ('Copy invoice', 'Copy link').
fixes: Receive desktop: restyle QR card with a dedicated dark container, 16px padding, subtle border (#222433), and inverted high-contrast quiet QR code or refined warm-white card with inner shadow.
Receive desktop: consolidate 'Copy invoice', 'Copy link', and deep link into a unified segmented action group or dropdown trigger.
Receive desktop: bring the left column inputs directly into an aligned cohesive panel card matching the dimensions of the right column SHARE panels.

top_issues: Swap desktop: extreme empty space under the Swap primary action button across the entire lower screen.
Swap desktop: swap direction toggle icon button between the two token cards has zero container elevation or hover target boundary.
Swap desktop: secondary helper text ('The order rests on this account at that price until Hub One fills it') lacks rate clarity—there is no explicit exchange rate (e.g. 1 WETH = X USDC) displayed.
fixes: Swap desktop: display an explicit dynamic exchange rate row (e.g. '1 WETH ≈ 3,240.50 USDC · Fee 0.05%') directly above the Swap button.
Swap desktop: enclose the switch arrow icon in a circular pill button with 1px border (#2A2D3D) and surface background (#161822).
Swap desktop: add an open orders / resting orderbook summary widget in the lower area to balance vertical height against the viewport.

top_issues: Account desktop: the multi-color visceral value bar (collateral/credit line/owed/in flight) is rich, but the legend items above it sit on a detached single line with minimal spacing distinction between colors.
Account desktop: 'Show 2 empty lanes · WETH, USDT' is a raw blue text string with insufficient hit affordance.
Account desktop: right card 'THIS ACCOUNT' has high informational value but terminates halfway down, leaving the bottom half of the right column empty.
fixes: Account desktop: format the legend directly as interactive indicators with monetary values (e.g., green dot + 'Collateral: $0.00', amber dot + 'Owed: $9,975.00').
Account desktop: convert 'Show 2 empty lanes' into a bordered outline button or table footer accordion item.
Account desktop: anchor an Account History / Recent Account Frames list directly beneath the primary account card to utilize desktop height.

top_issues: Activity desktop: list items contain no inline visceral bars to show proportional transfer magnitudes against the account scale.
Activity desktop: entire lower half of the page is completely empty when the transaction list is short (4 items), making the fixed right inspection panel feel bottom-heavy.
Activity desktop: filter chips ('All', 'Payments', 'Swaps', 'Settlement', 'Accounts') have subtle boundaries that blend excessively into the background when unselected.
fixes: Activity desktop: add a 4px horizontal micro-bar on each row under the amount reflecting its relative size at the global scale.
Activity desktop: give the left feed list a min-height or sticky relationship to the detail panel, adding pagination / frame-range selectors at the bottom.
Activity desktop: give unselected filter pills a subtle 1px border (#232636) and text color rgba(255,255,255,0.7) for clear interactivity cues.

top_issues: Activity Detail desktop: identical state to 07-activity with active selection; the right drawer inspection card lacks a direct action button (e.g. 'View on explorer', 'Copy frame receipt', or 'Export dispute proof').
Activity Detail desktop: selected row in the left list has very faint visual affordance (minimal background tint difference) to signal which item is active.
Activity Detail desktop: 'Proof 0x2837ecf8...c263ce' truncation hides whether this is clickable to inspect or copy.
fixes: Activity Detail desktop: add a distinct active state indicator (2px left indigo border `#6E7CFF` and surface highlight `#181A26`) on the selected feed row.
Activity Detail desktop: add an explicit copy icon and tooltip to the Proof hash row.
Activity Detail desktop: provide an action footer inside the detail panel: 'Download cryptographic frame receipt' button.

top_issues: Settings desktop: scale slider and preview widget are exceptional, but preset chips ('Auto', '$1', '$2', '$5'...) wrap tightly under the slider track without clear separation from the Home section.
Settings desktop: Runtime ID hash (0xf39fd6e...) is not truncated and spans an awkward line length without an inline copy affordance.
Settings desktop: 'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Lock' buttons sit at the very bottom left with inconsistent pill border weight compared to CTA buttons on Pay/Receive.
fixes: Settings desktop: format the scale presets with equal-width segmented buttons or a unified compact selector bar with clear active indicator.
Settings desktop: truncate Runtime ID with an inline copy icon (`0xf39f...2266` + icon) matching account address patterns.
Settings desktop: add 32px bottom margin and elevate 'Reveal recovery phrase' to secondary button style with subtle warning accent on hover.

overall.verdict: The design achieves an elite, disciplined fintech aesthetic with authoritative typography, restraint in accent color, and an innovative absolute-scale visceral bar concept. Its primary weakness is responsive desktop spatial composition: generous vertical whitespace turns into empty dead voids on wider viewports across almost every secondary flow.
priority_fixes: Constrain desktop layout max-width or balance two-column modules to eliminate dead empty space across the lower halves of Home, Receive, Swap, and Activity.
Add a min-width (2px) and active state indicator for low-dollar entries on the visceral bar in Pay and Home so small transactions remain perceptible at $50/px.
Redesign the Receive screen QR code surface to eliminate dark-mode glare and harmonize its container styling with the rest of the dark card system.
Refactor visceral bar legends across Home, Pay, and Account from passive plain text into structured, data-dense metric captions directly bound to the bar segments.
Establish active selection states on Activity feed items and provide concrete cryptographic proof actions (copy frame proof, inspect signature) on transaction detail cards.
